steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local carrier=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(carrier.X,carrier.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==carrier.Free,'original work carrier is not Free Cities')
local owners,seen={},{}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
if not seen[carrier.Free] then owners[#owners+1]=carrier.Free end
local blockers={}
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
 local player=Players[owner]
 if player then for _,unit in player:GetUnits():Members() do
  if unit:GetX()==carrier.X and unit:GetY()==carrier.Y then blockers[#blockers+1]={Owner=owner,ID=unit:GetID(),Type=GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].UnitType,Damage=unit:GetDamage(),Moves=unit:GetMovesRemaining()} end
 end end
end
table.sort(blockers,function(a,b) if a.Owner~=b.Owner then return a.Owner<b.Owner end return a.ID<b.ID end)
local moved={}
for _,entry in ipairs(blockers) do
 local unit=assert(UnitManager.GetUnit(entry.Owner,entry.ID))
 local placed=false
 for x=carrier.X-6,carrier.X+6 do for y=carrier.Y-6,carrier.Y+6 do
  local plot=Map.GetPlot(x,y)
  if not placed and plot and plot:GetOwner()==entry.Owner and not plot:IsWater() and not plot:IsImpassable() and (x~=carrier.X or y~=carrier.Y) then
   local units=Map.GetUnitsAt(plot)
   if not units or units:GetCount()==0 then
    UnitManager.PlaceUnit(unit,x,y)
    if unit:GetX()==x and unit:GetY()==y then
     if unit:GetDamage()~=entry.Damage then unit:SetDamage(entry.Damage) end
     if unit:GetMovesRemaining()~=entry.Moves then unit:ChangeMovesRemaining(entry.Moves-unit:GetMovesRemaining()) end
     assert(unit:GetID()==entry.ID and unit:GetOwner()==entry.Owner and GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].UnitType==entry.Type and unit:GetDamage()==entry.Damage and unit:GetMovesRemaining()==entry.Moves,'center unit identity or state changed')
     entry.X,entry.Y=x,y;moved[#moved+1]=entry;placed=true
    end
   end
  end
 end end
 assert(placed,'no empty owned plot to preserve carrier center unit '..entry.Owner..':'..entry.ID)
end
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do local player=Players[owner];if player then for _,unit in player:GetUnits():Members() do assert(unit:GetX()~=carrier.X or unit:GetY()~=carrier.Y,'carrier center still occupied') end end end
local works=A.NativeWorkLocations(carrier.WorkIndex)
assert(#works==1 and works[1].Owner==carrier.Free and works[1].X==carrier.X and works[1].Y==carrier.Y,'fixture relocation altered original work')
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_RECOVERY_CENTER_CLEAR',moved)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_RECOVERY_CENTER_CLEAR] moved='..#moved..' city='..city:GetID())
return 'carrier center units preserved on empty owned plots before valid recovery'

local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-scatter-flow:native-work:2'
local world=assert(F.GetWorld(id))
assert(world.Status=='WAIT_CLEAR' and world.Kind=='ITEM' and world.AssetID=='native-work:2','reward state changed')
local plot=assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(world.Site))
assert(plot:GetImprovementType()==world.Improvement,'actual reward improvement absent')
local original=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
local carrier=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
assert(#original==1 and original[1].Owner==carrier.Free and original[1].X==carrier.X and original[1].Y==carrier.Y and original[1].Building==carrier.Building and original[1].Slot==carrier.Slot,'original work not in Free Cities exact carrier')
local target=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW')).HumanSlot
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==target.Owner and city:GetID()==target.City and A.CityAssets(city).BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[target.Slot]==-1,'recovery target changed')
local before={};for _,unit in Players[1]:GetUnits():Members() do before[unit:GetID()]=true end
UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(1,'UNIT_WARRIOR',plot:GetX(),plot:GetY(),8)
local claimant
for _,unit in Players[1]:GetUnits():Members() do if not before[unit:GetID()] and GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].UnitType=='UNIT_WARRIOR' then assert(not claimant,'ambiguous reward claimant');claimant=unit end end
assert(claimant,'reward claimant not created')
UnitManager.PlaceUnit(claimant,plot:GetX(),plot:GetY())
assert(claimant:GetX()==plot:GetX() and claimant:GetY()==plot:GetY(),'claimant did not reach site')
ImprovementBuilder.SetImprovementType(plot,-1,-1)
assert(plot:GetImprovementType()~=world.Improvement,'reward site was not cleared')
F.Tick()
world=assert(F.GetWorld(id))
assert((world.Status=='CLAIMED' or world.Status=='COMPLETE') and world.Recipient==1,'real site did not trigger product claim: '..tostring(world.Error))
local recovery=assert(A.GetState().Recoveries['recovery:'..id])
assert(recovery.ID=='native-work:2' and recovery.Owner==1,'recovery intent did not preserve original identity')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_CLAIMED] world='..world.Status..' recovery='..recovery.Status..' site='..world.Site)
return 'real claimant cleared site and product recovery started'

steps.code:
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-scatter-flow:native-work:2'
local world=assert(F.GetWorld(id))
assert(world.Status=='COMPLETE' and world.Recipient==1,'world recovery incomplete: '..tostring(world.Error))
local intent=assert(A.GetState().Recoveries['recovery:'..id])
assert(intent.Status=='COMPLETE' and intent.NativePhysicalMoved and intent.NativeCarrier and intent.NativeCarrier.Phase=='PROVED','native product carrier not physically proved')
local target=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW')).HumanSlot
local carrier=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==1 and found[1].CityID==target.City and found[1].X==target.X and found[1].Y==target.Y and found[1].Building==target.Building and found[1].Slot==target.Slot,'original index missing from exact human Temple')
local free=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(carrier.X,carrier.Y))
assert(free:GetOwner()==carrier.Free and A.CityAssets(free).BUILDING_TEMPLE.Works[carrier.Slot]==-1,'borrowed Free Cities carrier not returned empty')
local original=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_FLOW')).Source
for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do assert(found[1][key]==original[key],'recovered original metadata changed: '..key) end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(found[1].Effects,original.Effects),'recovered original effects changed')
local item=assert(A.GetRoster(1)['native-work:2'])
assert(item.Outcome=='RECOVERED' and item.RecoveryToken=='recovery:'..id and item.NativeCustody.Owner==1 and item.NativeCustody.City==target.City and item.NativeCustody.Building==target.Building and item.NativeCustody.Slot==target.Slot,'recovered roster does not match real original')
local before=A.Canonical({World=world,Record=item,Recovery=intent})
F.Tick()
assert(A.Canonical({World=F.GetWorld(id),Record=A.GetRoster(1)['native-work:2'],Recovery=A.GetState().Recoveries['recovery:'..id]})==before,'repeated recovery changed completed identity')
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_RECOVERED] index=2 owner=1 city='..found[1].CityID..' world='..world.Status)
return 'product recovered the original index exactly once through real reward site'
